plugin.name: zone-picker
plugin._long: While a window is dragged toward the top of a screen a plate of layouts is offered there, and a drop on one of its zones tiles the window to that part of the screen. The plate itself is drawn by a program that asks through the control socket (method "zone-picker/watch").

option.name: enabled
option._long: Whether the plate is offered at all.

option.name: layouts
option._long: The layouts on the plate, split by "|". Each is a list of zones split by ";", and a zone is "name,x,y,width,height" in percent of the room windows may use.

option.name: distance
option._long: How many pixels below the top of the room for windows the pointer wakes the plate.

option.name: peek
option._long: How many pixels of the plate show once it is woken. The pointer opens it there.

option.name: padding
option._long: Pixels between the plate's rim and its layouts, and between the plate and the screen's sides.

option.name: gutter
option._long: Pixels between two zones of one layout.

option.name: margin
option._long: How many pixels outside the open plate the pointer may stray before it closes.

option.name: mini_share
option._long: How wide a layout is drawn, as a share of the screen's width.

option.name: mini_min
option._long: The fewest pixels wide a layout is drawn.

option.name: mini_max
option._long: The most pixels wide a layout is drawn.

option.name: window_opacity
option._long: How opaque the dragged window is while the plate is open. It is drawn above the plate, so at 1 it hides the layouts under it.

option.name: window_fade_ms
option._long: How many milliseconds the dragged window takes to turn see-through and back.
